exposure: induction of labour using a double-balloon catheter
Induction of labor with double-balloon catheter and sequential oral misoprostol
Induction of labor with oral misoprostol alone
cohort: Women undergoing induction of labor with oral misoprostol or double-balloon catheter with sequential oral misoprostol in singleton pregnancies at term
finding: Double-balloon catheter and sequential oral misoprostol without long delay after catheter removal resulted in a lower cesarean section rate and shorter induction-to-delivery interval compared to oral misoprostol alone.
mod_finding: Using a double-balloon catheter followed by oral misoprostol for labor induction resulted in a lower cesarean section rate compared to oral misoprostol alone.
